drhp.business: ELANTAS Beck India manufactures speciality chemicals for electrical insulation and construction industries, including wire enamels, impregnating resins and varnishes, flexible electrical insulation materials, electronic compounds, specialty coatings and engineering materials. Its products serve transportation, automotive, power generation and distribution, industrial systems, e-mobility, wind energy and consumer sectors, combining local manufacturing with global ALTANA/ELANTAS technology.

risks.note: Volatility in market demand may affect order flows, production planning, and revenue visibility across key segments.

Dependence on specific geographies for procurement could expose the supply chain to geopolitical tensions, regulatory changes, or trade restrictions, affecting raw material availability, logistics timelines, and operational continuity.

Sharp and unexpected increases in the prices of certain key raw materials during the year added pressure, and in some cases availability became constrained, with the potential to impact production continuity, cost structures, and overall operational stability.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility and availability

sk.overview: India's industrial catalyst and adsorbent ecosystem plays a critical role in enabling efficient, sustainable, and high-quality production across refining, petrochemical, chemical, fertilizer, and gas-processing industries. These materials, ranging from process-specific catalysts to high-performance adsorbents and inert ceramic support media, are essential for purification, dehydration, sulphur removal, hydro processing, cracking, and environmental compliance.
